items.title: Amazon.com (AMZN) Is Negotiating Muse AI Access To Its Shopping Platform
items.summary: Amazon.com (NasdaqGS:AMZN) is in talks with Meta to restore Muse AI agent access to Amazon's shopping platform. Negotiations are focused on how Muse driven shopping activity would interact with Amazon's digital advertising formats and pricing. Meta already routes Muse users to Walmart's Black Friday offers, creating pressure on Amazon's position in AI assisted shopping.
